activities.title: 1st Video Editing Assignment - Launch and Rough Cut
activities.dueLabel: Build the exactly 30-second rough cut by the end of class
activities.summary: Import and organize the provided media, assemble an exactly 30-second timeline, and complete a rough pacing check before polishing.

activities.title: 1st Video Editing Assignment - Polish, Render, and Submit
activities.dueLabel: Final MP4 and evidence link due by the end of class
activities.sourceTiming: Assignment edited Nov 12, 2025; render material posted Nov 14, 2025
activities.summary: Polish pacing, readable text, and audio balance, then use How to Render in DaVinci to export, verify playback, and submit evidence.

activities.title: 2nd Video Editing Assignment - The Redo: Revision Plan
activities.dueLabel: Revision plan and rebuilt rough cut due by the end of class
activities.summary: Review the first edit, identify specific improvements, and rebuild the 30-second sequence with stronger flow, pacing, titles, and storytelling.

activities.title: 2nd Video Editing Assignment - The Redo: Final Edit and Critique
activities.dueLabel: Improved final export and evidence link due by the end of class
activities.summary: Finish the improved edit, export and verify the MP4, compare it with the first version, and participate in a focused peer critique.

activities.title: 1st Group Project: The Duel - Preproduction and Shot Plan
activities.dueLabel: Concept, roles, locations, and 6-10-shot plan due by the end of class
activities.summary: Assign rotating production roles and plan a safe 20-30 second visual duel with clear story beats, composed shots, music, and sound effects.

activities.title: 1st Group Project: The Duel - Production
activities.dueLabel: Capture all planned footage and organize the production files
activities.summary: Film the planned 6-10 shots, rotate responsibilities, monitor continuity and safety, and organize footage for the edit.

activities.title: 1st Group Project: The Duel - Edit, Screen, and Submit
activities.dueLabel: Final 20-30 second film and evidence link due by the end of class
activities.sourceTiming: Duel edited Dec 1, 2025; absent work posted Dec 9, 2025
activities.summary: Edit, sound-design, export, screen, and submit the Duel. Students absent from production complete The Duel Absent Work analysis instead.

activities.title: Group Project 2: The Movie Line Challenge - Preproduction
activities.dueLabel: Interpretation, role rotation, and shot plan due by the end of class
activities.summary: Interpret the assigned movie line, develop a clear 30-40 second story, assign roles, and create a practical production plan.

activities.title: Group Project 2: The Movie Line Challenge - Production and Edit
activities.dueLabel: Complete principal photography and assemble the rough cut
activities.summary: Capture the planned footage, rotate production roles, organize media, and assemble a rough cut with intentional composition and pacing.

activities.title: Group Project 2: The Movie Line Challenge - Final Cut and Screening
activities.dueLabel: Final 30-40 second film and evidence link due by the end of class
activities.summary: Polish the edit with music and sound design, export and verify the final film, screen it for feedback, and submit the evidence link.

activities.title: Group Project 3: The Genre Challenge - Preproduction and Production
activities.dueLabel: Genre plan, role rotation, shot list, and footage due by the end of class
activities.summary: Choose a clear genre approach, plan a 35-45 second visual story with 6-10 shots, rotate roles, and capture the required footage.

activities.title: Group Project 3: The Genre Challenge - Final Edit, Screening, and Submission
activities.dueLabel: Final 35-45 second genre film and evidence link due by the end of class
activities.summary: Complete the edit with purposeful pacing, music, and sound effects, screen the film, reflect on the genre choices, and submit evidence.
